The previous condition was too lenient, only checking for a return value of zero, which did not adequately capture all failure scenarios. By changing the condition to check for `ret <= 0`, the code now correctly identifies failures, thereby improving the robustness of the error handling in the eDP initialization process. This change is linked to the previous commit identified by the hash `d112a8163f83`, which introduced eDP support, indicating that the error handling was not properly aligned with the expected behavior of the function.
